parsed.summary: The PR correctly resolves the issue by making Field.__hash__() immutable, but it introduces a potential behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The change to Field.__hash__() may break existing behavior where fields are used in dictionaries after being assigned to model classes. This could affect any code relying on the current hash behavior.
